resolvedContractFindings: DSO-010, DSO-011, and DSO-012 are derived requirements with ledger-resolved provenance
DSO-012 derives from both USR-009-E05 and USR-009-E06 and treats user proposals as design inputs rather than mandates
the example context allowlist includes every root mandatory context file
the production coordinator runtime is removed while legacy state is compatibility-only and quarantined
acknowledgement uses a per-job timer independent of the 60-second supervisor and Discord polling
Linux systemd ownership is documented as process-lifetime kernel flock locking
the shared kernel lock is credential-token-derived and the service verifies both token fingerprint and Gateway READY identity
managed Linux and direct or Windows launches all acquire the same fail-closed token owner record
a complete same-host same-boot owner record is crash-reclaimed only after the recorded PID is objectively absent, while ambiguity and PID reuse remain fail-closed
a missing service PID is immediately stopped so restart ownership and supervision cannot remain falsely healthy
invalid managed runtime identity is rejected before token ownership is acquired
attach and ownership failures terminate the complete detached POSIX process group
ACK and control sends are aborted and settled before Gateway drain, including abort of the underlying timed-out ACK send

backend leader exit and inherited stream drain are bounded separately; every negative-PID signal requires an exact current leader-identity match, and unavailable post-exit identity falls back to stream teardown plus service-manager/cgroup containment
status projection PATCH and pin requests inherit shutdown cancellation and cannot perform late fallback, persistence, or pin side effects
durable sent-or-missed acknowledgement evidence prevents duplicate ACK during exact-v2 recovery
schema-v2 recovery retains only the bounded current request and binding digests, requires an exact managed runtime revision, and reconstructs context from current verified files
normal Linux installation and rollback share one immutable Git runtime-artifact builder and verifier, so mutable checkout bytes cannot impersonate an installed revision
managed service and supervisor launches require explicit mode plus complete artifact markers before config reads, token ownership, or observation; missing markers cannot fall back to direct mode
existing Linux registrations cannot be overwritten by ordinary install unless the active bundle proves the installed source, deployed candidate, and clean candidate controller
prepare, verify, canary, and rollback all use one absolute candidate CLI path
prepare refuses installed-unit or running-service runtime identity that differs from target HEAD
every cutover phase re-verifies the clean candidate controller revision and runtime tree
rollback manifest verification binds the recorded config schema version to the preserved config bytes
prepare and restore validate the preserved config with the materialized source runtime's actual loader and bind the loader/config receipt into the manifest
canary requires exact equality among job acceptance, execution, current service, and supervisor generations plus exact enabled and active Linux service/timer registrations

canary rejects revision-label lookalikes and requires host-recomputed durable schema-v2 instance, agent/workspace, context, participant authority, config, and read-only access evidence from real router admission
canary requires a durable accepted authorized Discord ingress record and historical-only attention remains visible without permanently vetoing a new healthy canary
the first managed cutover adopts only the exact verified legacy unit bytes and rechecks their manifest binding before replacement

rollback bundle verification completes before the active pointer is published, the complete Linux registration mutation is enclosed by one failure boundary, and Windows install rejects both main-service and supervisor residue before launcher creation until versioned cutover exists while first-install autoStart=false publishes only a disabled Startup fallback
service status, stop, and disable inspect the installed registration without parsing malformed candidate configuration

watchdog and supervisor use one oldest-first operational snapshot capped at 256 jobs, aggregate active and historical-attention counts, and explicit unhealthy overflow while operator job pages are bounded

failed install artifacts are removed only when unreferenced, while install, cutover preparation, rollback, and explicit prune share one per-instance kernel flock that auto-releases and cleans readiness evidence on process death while retaining installed and active rollback assets
the default non-XDG Unix token-owner namespace is boot-scoped while explicitly shared directories retain strict fail-closed semantics
backend version-probe process-group termination requires an exact immutable leader-identity match before any negative-PID signal and falls back to leader-only cleanup when identity is unavailable
the OnMam live named-instance rollout remains explicitly deferred and cannot be claimed complete from generic support alone
the Korean operator manual includes named-instance commands and per-instance config and ledger paths
canary and rollback are specified fail-closed with explicit evidence and phase ordering
